what: Overfit test of the FM velocity field on ONE 8-cloud batch: 10000 AdamW steps at lr 1e-3, fixed t.  Compares the reachable loss with the v=0 baseline and with the best radial-only field, which is the form EGNNVelocityField's dominant term can express.
honest_limits: The trajectory is ALWAYS evaluated on the fixed first cohort at t=0.5, whatever the training distribution was, so arms with different --cycle-batches / --t-uniform settings are comparable.
One batch, one t (0.5).  A field that fits t=0.5 need not fit the whole path; a field that cannot fit t=0.5 cannot fit the path.

The radial ceiling is computed on the SAME batch, so it is an upper bound on the radial term only — `last_v` (the edge-mean term) can in principle beat it.  A measured MSE at the radial ceiling means the model is using the radial term alone.
lr 1e-3 is 10x the training lr (1e-4); this is deliberately generous to the field, so a failure is not a learning-rate artefact.
